title: RAG Architecture
html:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation grounds LLM answers in external source documentation.

Complete RAG Pipeline Flow

1. Parse Docs
PDFs, HTML, Markdown
→
2. Chunking
Size: 512, Overlap: 50
→
3. Embed
Text -> 1536-dim vector
→
4. Store
Vector DB Index
5. User Query
"How to refund?"
→
6. Retrieval
Vector Cosine Search
→
7. Context Inject
Format prompt with facts
→
8. LLM Answer
Fact-grounded response

Key Concepts

Chunking & Overlap

To avoid overflowing the context window and diluting semantic signals, text must be split into logical chunks. Overlap (e.g., 10%) ensures semantic continuity between adjacent chunks so information split at boundaries isn't lost.

Context Injection

The top-k retrieved snippets are formatted into the prompt wrapper template. Example system instruction: "Answer the query using ONLY the provided contexts below. If you don't know, say I don't know."
